description: Metadata and code-interpreter-session eligibility for a single Synapse file (a FileEntity or RecordSet). Used by an agent to decide whether a file can be added to a session before attempting to add it, and to obtain the fileHandleAssociation that identifies the file when adding it. The file-handle contents (fileName, contentType, contentSizeBytes) and the derived isSupportedType/isWithinSizeLimit flags can only be read when the user can download the file, so they are null when canDownload is false.

entityId.description: The Synapse ID of the file that was described (e.g. 'syn123').

fileHandleAssociation.description: The association that identifies this file's content. Pass this to the add-files-to-session tool to add the file. Null only if the entity could not be resolved to a FileEntity or RecordSet.

canDownload.description: True if the user has permission to download this file. When false, the file cannot be added to a session and the file-handle content fields are null.

isSupportedType.description: True if the file's type is one that can be added to a session (PDF, CSV, TXT, or JSON). Null if the user cannot download the file.

isWithinSizeLimit.description: True if the file is small enough to be added to a session. Null if the user cannot download the file.

canAddToSession.description: True only if the file can be added to a session: the user can download it, it is backed by S3 storage, its type is supported, and it is within the size limit.

fileName.description: The name of the file. Null if the user cannot download the file.

contentType.description: The content type of the file. Null if the user cannot download the file.

contentSizeBytes.description: The size of the file in bytes. Null if the user cannot download the file.

reason.description: A human-readable explanation of why the file cannot be added to a session, when canAddToSession is false. Null when the file can be added.
